subject: Recap: Leadership discussion - decision asks & procurement path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@harmoniahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T15:02:00Z
Subject: Recap: Leadership discussion - decision asks & procurement path

Thanks again Claire and Tom — appreciated the time today. Quick recap and explicit asks so we have a single action list for leadership and procurement.

Key pains you confirmed
- Inference latency spikes for weekend batch scoring causing downstream SLA misses (p95 currently ~420ms at peak).
- Unpredictable token spend on the current hosted solution; cost overruns when volumes burst.
- Strong compliance bar: E2E auditability, data residency for PHI-adjacent metadata, and SOC 2 evidence for security controls.

Primary outcomes you want
- Pilot that proves predictable p95 < 250ms under your real traffic pattern (including weekend bursts).
- Clear unit economics for 1M+ tokens/month and a path to scale on Dedicated or Private with predictable pricing.
- Compliance deliverables (SOC2 snapshot, KMS integration checklist) to satisfy internal GRC sign-off.

Risk / blockers we flagged
- Legal procurement timeline may push beyond Q3 if SOC2 evidence is not provided quickly.
- If Dedicated capacity is required, lead time for reserved pool allocation could be ~6 weeks after contract execution.

Proposed procurement path (next steps & owners)
1) Redwood to send a one-page pilot SOW and pricing strawman (Ben) — target: 2026-05-18 EOD. Attachment: Harmonia-MAP-v2.pdf (pilot scope & metrics).
2) Harmonia legal / procurement to confirm timetable and any required form contracts (Claire) — can you confirm by 2026-05-21?
3) Harmonia security to request SOC2 snapshot & KMS guidance (Tom) — Redwood will attach SOC2-snapshot.pdf and a KMS integration checklist.
4) Marissa / Sales Ops to prepare a procurement-ready quote with an optional 90-day Dedicated pilot and an ops SLA addendum (Marissa).

Attachments: Harmonia-MAP-v2.pdf (pilot SOW draft), SOC2-snapshot.pdf (Redwood controls summary).

Acceptance ask
- Please reply with any changes to the pilot scope above and confirm whether procurement/contracting cadence can meet the target dates. If acceptable, we’ll route the SOW + quote to DocuSign and thread in Sales Ops.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwood.inference.com
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@harmoniahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@harmoniahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T17:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: Leadership discussion - decision asks & procurement path

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with our internal read. A few clarifications from our side:

- For the p95 target, can you confirm whether the 250ms target is measured from frontend request-to-first-token or from service egress? Our engineering team measures both and we need the same baseline.
- On cost: we’d like a usage banding model in the strawman (0-1M / 1-5M / 5M+ tokens) with committed discount tiers.
- Legal wants any standard Redwood T&Cs plus an overview of data handling for PHI metadata — I’ll cc Melissa Grant from GRC once she’s back from travel.

We can confirm procurement timeline by 2026-05-21 as long as we get the SOC2 snapshot and the SOW this week. Thanks for moving quickly.

Claire Jensen
VP, Data & Analytics | Harmonia Health
claire.jensen@harmoniahealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:05:00Z
Subject: internal: Harmonia -> escalate pricing & SOC2 evidence prep

Ben / Rishi — quick internal note following Claire’s reply.

Action items for Redwood (internal owners):
- Sales Ops: prepare a banded pricing quote with committed tiers + optional Dedicated 90-day pilot pricing. Ask: include a one-time ramp credit for the pilot to accelerate evaluation (salesops).
- Security team: finalize a SOC2 snapshot package and a short KMS/HSM integration note for PHI-adjacent metadata (ask security to attach SOC2-snapshot.pdf). Target ETA: 48 hours.
- Legal: identify any standard clause asks that regularly slow Harmonia deals (data residency, subprocessing, indemnity caps). I’ll pull precedent.

Please prioritize — Harmonia is timeboxed and the procurement lane looks active. Rishi, flag any discount approvals we should pre-authorize for a pilot to avoid delays.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@harmoniahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: Leadership discussion - decision asks & procurement path

Claire — thanks, noted. Short answers inline and attached updated SOW + pricing strawman.

- Measurement baseline: our SLOs are frontend request-to-first-token by default; we’ll include p95 request-to-first-token numbers in the pilot harness so your engineers can validate parity.
- Pricing: attached banded model and committed tiers in Harmonia-MAP-v2.pdf — we included a pilot ramp credit line item for the 90-day Dedicated pilot option.
- Compliance: attached SOC2-snapshot.pdf and a one-page KMS integration checklist. If Melissa or your GRC team want a quick 30-min call, we can schedule a security deep-dive this week.

Next logistics
- I’ll upload the SOW + quote to HubSpot and set up DocuSign routing once you confirm procurement timeline: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4621
- If legal needs a form contract review, please route it to marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com and we’ll prioritize.

Attachments: Harmonia-MAP-v2.pdf, SOC2-snapshot.pdf

Looking forward — Ben
